scores.claim_text: Extensive granted-patent portfolio in digital lidar (VCSEL/SPAD/micro-optic).
scores.M_value: USPTO ODP: 76 granted patents pre-cutoff; category hits lidar=71, optic=39, spad=2, vcsel=0 (167 total apps).
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 8 satisfied: n_granted >> 10 with strong hits in claimed core areas (lidar, optic, SPAD); patent-coverage claim is corroborated.

scores.claim_text: DF solid-state lidar designed for automotive OEM ADAS production wins.
scores.M_value: EDGAR FTS: 0 hits for 'Ouster' in Aptiv (CIK 0001521332) 10-K/20-F/8-K filings.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational): filing language is 'prototypes' / 'will meet requirements' / 'positioned to capture' — pre-SOP and no named OEM design-win or SOP date; no Tier-1 (Aptiv) counterparty corroboration. Claim is aspirational, not a hard contradiction (no series-production claim asserted), so MODERATE rather than RED.

scores.claim_text: Two customers each >10% of revenue in FY2025 (customer concentration).
scores.M_value: No M-source can verify identity of >10% customers; OUST does not name them in the disclosure quoted.
scores.interpretation: Customer-concentration percentage is a self-reported segment-disclosure fact with no named counterparties to cross-check; unverifiable without identification. Flagged as disclosure-quality risk (anonymous concentration in a diversified-customer narrative) but no M-source rebuttal possible.

scores.claim_text: Higher-volume manufacturing outsourced to Benchmark Electronics and Fabrinet in Thailand.
scores.M_value: EDGAR FTS for 'Ouster' across 10-K/10-Q: 245 hits, dominated by Ouster's own filings/subsidiary lists; no targeted Benchmark/Fabrinet CIK probe available within 1-query cap.
scores.interpretation: Manufacturing-partner relationships with Benchmark and Fabrinet are operational facts; broad EDGAR full-text search returns mostly self-references and cannot directly corroborate either counterparty's contractual relationship in a single query. Low forensic risk but unverifiable with the allotted M-source budget.

scores.claim_text: $211.2M liquidity supports >=12 months operations despite $973.4M accumulated deficit.
scores.M_value: FY2025 net loss $60.4M; FY2024 net loss $97.0M; operating cash burn $40.0M FY25; $97.5M raised via ATM in FY25 at $20.88/share; ATM remaining capacity only $2.5M; reverse stock split referenced; accumulated deficit $973.4M.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 10-adjacent: while no Form 15 / 25-NSE filed, the ATM is essentially exhausted ($2.5M remaining of $100M), historical reliance on equity issuance to fund losses, and large accumulated deficit relative to liquidity make the 12-month runway dependent on continued operating-loss reduction or new financing. Disclosure-quality issue: 'adequate for 12 months' is true under current burn but understates dilution/financing risk implicit in covering recurring losses. MODERATE.
